Why `Clause-②: yes`: the claim cannot yet say whether the reassign can be described with existing copy. A new `approvalsInbox.*` key would widen `@object-ui/i18n`'s exported `TranslationKeys` (precedent: objectui#13159). 「拿不准 ⇒ 按 `yes`」. The dev reports which it was.
